newsitem.title: USA: American Pacific names John Gibson CEO/Pre.
newsitem.headline: American Pacific names John Gibson CEO/Pre.

text.p: American Pacific Corp said Tuesday that John Gibson was named chief executive and president, effective July 16.

The company said Gibson has been the company's vice president of engineering and operations since 1992 and has served as president of the company's American Azide Corp subsidiary and most recently as the principal operating officer of all of the Company's subsidiaries other than its real estate ventures.
A news release issued by the company said Fred Gibson Jr will continue as chairman until the next annual shareholder's meeting of the company scheduled for March 1998.
The news release said Fred Gibson Jr will remain available to the company as a consultant for special projects.
American Pacific Corp is a specialty chemical company that produces products used primarily in space flight and defense systems, automotive airbag safety systems, and fire extinguishment systems.
